bandReport.notes: 23 questions, Q98-Q120, no gaps. Q98 begins cleanly at the head of p17's left column (booklet page 35-A), so nothing continues in from B3's last page. THE PAPER GENUINELY ENDS AT Q120: p21 (booklet page 43-A) carries Q117/Q118 left and Q119/Q120 right, and below Q120's option (d) there is only the footer 'ANFB-S-GKL (43-A)' — verified by cropping the page foot at 4x. p21 is the last page of the 22-page PDF (indices 0-21) and is NOT blank. There is no trailing rough-work page IN THIS PDF, but the scan clearly omits them: the rendered pages carry booklet page numbers 35-A, 37-A, 39-A, 41-A, 43-A — odd only, +2 per rendered page — and 22 rendered pages x 2 - 1 = 43, so every rendered page is an odd booklet page and the even (verso) pages were dropped. Those versos are the rough-work pages: mirrored show-through of the words 'SPACE FOR ROUGH WORK' is visible in the p20 and p21 renders. No questions are lost by that omission. Nothing on my pages belongs to a neighbouring band. Every page is cleanly two-column with the vertical rule intact; no question straddles the column break, and no option block is orphaned from its stem. PDF has NO text layer at all (get_text() returns 0 chars on all 22 pages), so every reading here is from the page image; all 23 option blocks were re-checked label-by-label against 6-12x crops from the source PDF.
